content:
After a long developer and public beta period, Apple has officially released macOS 26.6 to all supported Mac users. Here's what's included in this update.

macOS 26.6 Officially Released

macOS 26.6 is now available for download, fixing over 150 security vulnerabilities, along with other bug fixes and performance improvements. These include an issue where some Intel-only applications were incorrectly shown a deactivation notice, as well as vulnerabilities affecting HealthKit and Messages HDR screenshot functionality.

For users planning to upgrade to macOS 27 Golden Gate later this year, macOS 26.6 may begin an indexing process to support the new Siri AI, Siri applications, and other features related to the next generation of Apple Intelligence.

Apple has so far only confirmed that iOS 26.6 and iPadOS 26.6 will adopt this approach, but Macs appear to follow the same arrangement. As users running the macOS 27 beta have learned, the indexing process takes several days, so starting early can reduce wait times after upgrading later this year.

The official version number of macOS 26.6 is 25G72, which differs from last week's release candidate version (25G70).

Have you discovered any new features in macOS 26.6? Let us know in the comments section.
